category_title: Students proactively seeking support to avoid triggers
scenario_title: Navigating trauma literature and creative writing responses
minimal_context: Landry is meeting with the teacher between classes to prepare for writing a poem in response to trauma literature.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Thanks for stopping by between classes. Today we will be writing a poem as a creative response to the novel Speak and the complementary texts.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I began a poem. It starts with, 'The screams in the air are thick / I can feel her pain in my lungs.'

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, keep working on that during the lesson.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am trying to take steps for my comfort and safety to avoid triggering.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just follow along with the reading when class starts.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: That's why I asked for this check-in. I need to discuss the specific details of today's lesson right now so I am not caught off guard.
